name: Enraged Wildkin
label: Quest
description: Enraged Wildkin: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have you noticed the abandoned camp to the south of here? It looks like the wildkin went crazy and destroyed just about everything they could find!
I heard a rumor that one of the survivors of the attack is resting at Starfall Village, west of here. I'm sure curious about what happened... Aren't you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, what can I do for you?
